topic: Supermarket English: hurry up or I'm in a bit of a rush?

vars.why: Hurry up sounds bossy. Say sorry, I'm in a bit of a rush.
vars.polite: Sorry, I'm in a bit of a rush today.
vars.politeCard: Sorry, I'm in a bit of a rush.
vars.tip: start with excuse me. People are happier to help you.

title: "Hurry up"? Try "I'm in a bit of a rush"
